effectiveModel.cellStates: ground and first excited state of each converged rotor pendulum

measurementProtocol.preparation: prepare one marked pendulum in its first excited state and all other bulk cells in their ground state
measurementProtocol.measurement: record momentum-resolved oscillation frequencies and real-space spreading, fit E(k)=Delta+2t cos(k), and independently measure the many-body gap
measurementProtocol.heldOut: fit Delta and t below t/Delta=0.2, then predict the band edge at 0.3, 0.4 and 0.45
falsifiers: bandwidth differs from 4|t| beyond calibration tolerance
gap closes before the predicted band edge without resolved leakage from the two-level cell subspace
the fitted critical point drifts with even periodic system size
higher pendulum levels hybridize before the declared stress interval

established: an exactly solvable extensive local-perturbation lane with a quantitative gap closure at |t|=Delta/2 and a time-domain calibration protocol
boundary: This threshold belongs only to the number-conserving two-level excitation-hopping family. It is not the general Yarotsky stability radius and does not include higher pendulum levels, arbitrary symmetry-breaking terms, the chiral edge, or the rotor continuum limit.
